pages.name: Sicilian: Maroczy Bind, 7.Nc3 O-O 8.Be2 d6 9.O-O Nd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 rerouted the knight 'to c5 via b8'; plan 4 played ...Bd7 with the knight on d7. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Maroczy Bind, Breyer, 8.Qxg4 Nxd4 9.Qd1 e5 10.Bd3
pages.notes: Overview said White gave up the bishop pair (both sides keep two bishops after the knight trade); plan 1 played Nb3, which no knight can reach; plan 2 aimed for a ...d5 break the c4- and e4-pawns and Nc3 control. Rewrote overview and plans 1-3.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Alapin Variation, Sherzer Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 played Nc3-b5 with White's pawn on c3. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Delayed Alapin Variation, with e6
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the centre as an e4-d4 route; plan 4 put a knight on b4, which the c3-pawn covers. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: French Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: French Variation, Normal
pages.notes: Plan 3 played ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8. Rewrote plan 3.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Paulsen-Basman Defense
pages.notes: Overview called the c5-bishop light-squared (c5 is a dark square). Fixed the overview. Plan 3 is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-21 (reviewer: first draft had ...b5 supporting the c5-bishop).

pages.name: Sicilian: 2...e6 3.b3 Nc6
pages.notes: Overview called b2 a light-squared fianchetto; plan 1 'pinned' the c6-knight with Bb5 (the d7-pawn stands behind it). Rewrote plan 1, fixed the overview, and British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Open, 2...e6, 4.Nxd4 Nf6 5.Bd3 Nc6
pages.notes: British spelling in the overview. Plan 2 (recapture written as bxc6, an 'open' b-file) is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-21 (reviewer: first draft had a b7-bishop pressing e4 through the c6-pawn).

pages.name: Sicilian: Kan, 5.c4 Nf6 6.Nc3 Bb4
pages.notes: Plan 1 solidified with f3 without addressing the pin and the ...Nxe4 threat. Rewrote plan 1.

pages.name: Sicilian: Maroczy Bind, 5...Nf6 6.Nc3 d6 7.Be2 Nxd4 8.Qxd4 Bg7 9.Bg5
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 2026-11-16-18: plan 3 secured a d4-knight that has been exchanged. Rewrote plan 3 (reviewer: first draft left the queen in the g7-bishop's line).

pages.name: Sicilian: Maroczy Bind, 6.Nc2 Nf6 7.Nc3 d6 8.Be2 O-O 9.O-O Be6
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 2026-11-16-18: plan 4 rerouted a knight from b8 that stands on c6. Rewrote plan 4 (reviewer: first draft had a c5-knight pressuring c4).

pages.name: Sicilian: Maroczy Bind, 7.Nc3 O-O 8.Be2 d6 9.O-O Bd7 10.Qd2 Nxd4 11.Bxd4
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 2026-11-16-18: plan 3 pressed a c6-knight that has been exchanged. Rewrote plan 3 (reviewer: first draft gave White a c-file blocked by the c4-pawn).
